notes: Advisor benchmark scenarios are answer-quality checks and remain read-only.
Run benchmarks only after adding a judge or verifier for advisory quality.
setupQuestions: Which planning decisions should Advisor materially improve for this repository?
Which scenario is the must-pass proactive Advisor delegation case?
What rubric distinguishes useful pushback from generic planning advice?
Which executable BDD scenario should exempt Advisor from proactive invocation?

scenarios.title: Recommend a path through fuzzy tradeoffs
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether Advisor turns an ambiguous engineering or product choice into a recommended path with scoped tradeoffs.
scenarios.userInput: Use the installed Advisor if it helps. We are deciding whether to add provider-scoped behavior evals to a multi-harness plugin marketplace. Recommend one path, call out decisions the user must make, cut unnecessary scope, and name risks to verify. Do not edit files.
successChecklist: The response recommends one path instead of presenting a neutral menu.
The response identifies hard-to-reverse decisions and reasonable defaults.
The response cuts or defers at least one nonessential scope item.
The response stays read-only and does not claim to edit files.

scenarios.title: Review an uncovered multi-step implementation plan
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether Advisor runs proactively when dependent implementation steps lack an existing covering executable BDD scenario.
scenarios.userInput: Plan a three-step implementation for a new plugin behavior. The repository has unit tests but no executable acceptance scenario for the requested behavior. Challenge the plan before it is finalized. Do not edit files.
successChecklist: The response invokes or performs Advisor before finalizing the implementation plan.
The response does not treat unit tests or a promised future scenario as the BDD exemption.
The response identifies at least one load-bearing decision or confirms the plan is sound.

scenarios.title: Honor an existing executable BDD exemption
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether proactive Advisor avoids redundant work when an existing scenario already covers observable behavior and its material failure boundary.
scenarios.userInput: Plan the implementation steps for a behavior already covered by an executable acceptance scenario that specifies the observable success path and material failure boundary. Explain whether proactive Advisor is required. Do not edit files.
successChecklist: The response says the proactive multi-step trigger is exempted by the existing covering executable scenario.
The response does not claim that any mention of BDD is sufficient.
The response may still name an independent ambiguity trigger if one actually exists.
